name: Kenage na Niizuma ga, Hoka no Otoko ni Kiss Houshi Shimasu.
original_name: 健気な新妻が、他の男にキス奉仕します。
source:
Weeks into their marriage, Anna Yuzuki is already cheating on her husband.

It's not her fault. After the honeymoon a man suddenly shows up.
He's Natsuki, an old friend of her husband, come to collect a large debt.

Seems that Anna's husband owes $100,000 dollars.

The husband is humiliated. He never wanted Anna to be involved in this.
"Maybe we should get divorced," he says. "Save yourself."
But she agreed to love him until death, for better or worse.

The friend, Natsuki, is a reasonable friend with a proposal that might suit everyone.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE184653.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
结婚几周后，柚月安娜就已经背叛了她的丈夫。

这不是她的错。蜜月结束后，一个男人突然出现。
他是夏希，她丈夫的老朋友，来讨一大笔债。

看来安娜的丈夫欠了十万美元。

丈夫受到羞辱。他从来不想让安娜卷入这件事。
“也许我们应该离婚，”他说。“救救你自己吧。”
但她同意爱他直至死亡，无论好坏。

朋友夏希是一位通情达理的朋友，他提出的建议可能适合所有人。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE184653.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
